source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Chapter 8 (PDF 174-191), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 8 (Physical Optics and Gravitational Waves) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har 5 number ke theory sawal (definition, wazahat, derivation) ke baad usi mauzu ka 3 number ka numerical hai. Har sawal ka model jawab hai; numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 What is meant by polarization of light? Explain with the example of transverse waves on a string why only transverse waves can be polarized, and describe how unpolarized light can be made polarized. (5 marks)
(Light ki polarization se kya muraad hai? String par transverse waves ki misaal se wazahat karein ke sirf transverse waves hi kyun polarize hoti hain, aur batayein ke unpolarized light ko kaise polarized banaya jata hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Wave nature: Interference aur diffraction light ki wave nature sabit karte hain magar yeh nahi batate ke light longitudinal hai ya transverse. Polarization batati hai ke light transverse hai.

String par transverse waves (Fig. 8.1): Medium ke zarraat lehar ki simt ke amoodan vibrate karte hain. Vibration amoodi (vertical), ufqi (horizontal) ya kisi aur rukh mein ho sakti hai; har surat mein lehar polarized kehlati hai. Plane of polarization woh satah hai jis mein vibration ki simt aur lehar ke chalne ki simt hon.

Light: Hilte charge se bani light wave electric field vector E aur us ke saath magnetic field vector B ki daurai tabdeeli hai, dono aapas mein 90° par. Aam light ki vibrations har satah mein hoti hain; yeh unpolarized hai (sooraj, incandescent aur fluorescent bulb, mombatti, aag). Agar vibrations aik satah tak mehdood hon to light polarized hai.

Polarization: woh amal jis mein light ki electric aur magnetic vibrations aik satah tak mehdood ho jati hain. Yeh sirf transverse waves mein hoti hai; sound jaisi longitudinal waves mein nahi, kyunke un ki vibration chalne ki simt mein hoti hai.

Unpolarized light ko polarize karne ke tareeqay: (1) polaroid sheet jaisa polarizing filter; (2) polarizing beam splitter; (3) calcite aur quartz jaise crystals. Filter mein sirf woh electric field vector guzarta hai jo filter ke axis ke mutawazi ho; baqi ruk jaate hain, is liye nikalne wali light polarized hoti hai (Fig. 8.3).

Bunyad: electric field vector E ka aik khaas rukh mein hona polarization ki bunyad hai.

book_ref.quote: A light wave produced by oscillating charge consists of a periodic variation of the electric field vector

blocks.prompt:
2 Polarized light of amplitude 20 units falls on a polarizing filter whose axis makes 53° with the light's plane of vibration. Find the amplitude of the light that passes, and the fraction of the intensity transmitted. (3 marks)
(20 units amplitude ki polarized light aise polarizing filter par parti hai jis ka axis light ki vibration ki satah se 53° par hai. Guzarne wali light ka amplitude aur intensity ka guzarne wala hissa nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Sirf filter ke axis ke saath E ka component guzarta hai: A = A₀cos θ; intensity amplitude ke square ke mutabiq.

book_ref.quote: only that electric field vector which is parallel to the axis of polarized filter

blocks.final_answer: A = 12.0 units; intensity ka taqreeban 36% guzarta hai

blocks.prompt:
3 Classify the polarization of light. Describe linear, circular and elliptical polarization with one example of each. (5 marks)
(Light ki polarization ki darja-bandi karein. Linear, circular aur elliptical polarization ko aik aik misaal ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Electric field vector E jo raasta banata hai us ke mutabiq light ki polarization ki teen bunyadi qismein hain.

1. Linear polarization (Fig. 8.4 a): Electric field vector aik hi satah mein hilta hai. Misaal: sunglasses jaise polarizing filter se guzri light.

2. Circular polarization (Fig. 8.4 b): Electric field daaire mein ghoomta hai, clockwise (right-handed) ya counterclockwise (left-handed). Misaal: CD ya DVD se reflect hui light.

3. Elliptical polarization (Fig. 8.4 c): Linear aur circular ka milaap jis mein electric field vector bezawi (elliptical) raasta banata hai. Electric field ke do components Ex aur Ey barabar nahi hote aur/ya un mein kisi bhi angle θ ka phase farq hota hai. Misaal: stress plate ya waveplate se guzri light.

book_ref.quote: Here are the basic types of polarization of light.

blocks.prompt:
4 Linearly polarized light falls on an analyzer. Through what angle must the analyzer's axis be turned from the plane of vibration so that the transmitted amplitude is 0.9 of the incident amplitude? What fraction of the intensity then passes? (3 marks)
(Linearly polarized light analyzer par parti hai. Analyzer ka axis vibration ki satah se kitna ghumaya jaye ke guzarne wala amplitude asal amplitude ka 0.9 ho? Us waqt intensity ka kitna hissa guzrega?)
blocks.explanation: Angle ke liye A = A₀cos θ lagayein, phir I/I₀ = (A/A₀)².

book_ref.quote: When the electric field vector oscillates in a single plane

blocks.prompt:
5 How can plane polarized light be produced and detected using two polaroids? Explain what this experiment proves about the nature of light. (5 marks)
(Do polaroids ki madad se plane polarized light kaise paida aur pehchani jati hai? Wazahat karein ke yeh tajurba light ki fitrat ke baare mein kya sabit karta hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Unpolarized source: Aam incandescent bulb (aur Sooraj) ki light unpolarized hai kyunke is ki electrical vibrations space mein be-tarteeb hoti hain (Fig. 8.5).

Paida karna: Jab unpolarized light polaroid sheet (polarizer) par parti hai to guzarne wali light plane polarized hoti hai.

Pehchanna: Beam mein doosra polaroid (analyzer) rakha jata hai.
• Jab dono polaroids ke axes (un par khinchi lakeerein) mutawazi hon to light doosre polaroid se guzar jati hai (Fig. 8.5 a).
• Analyzer ko beam ke gird ahista ghumayein to light madham se madham hoti hai aur axes amoodi hone par ghaib ho jati hai (Fig. 8.5 b).
• Mazeed ghumane par light wapas aati hai aur axes phir mutawazi hon to sab se roshan hoti hai.

Kya sabit hota hai: Light waves transverse hain. Agar longitudinal hoteen to vibration chalne ki simt mein hoti aur polaroids amoodi hone par bhi light kabhi ghaib na hoti.

book_ref.quote: If unpolarized light is made incident on a sheet of polaroid (polarizer), the transmitted light will be plane polarized.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhein: book ki ibarat parallel polaroids ko Fig. 8.5-b kehti hai, magar sahi yeh hai ke parallel wala hissa (a) aur crossed wala hissa (b) hai.

blocks.prompt:
6 Plane polarized light of intensity 80 W m⁻² leaves a polarizer. Find the intensity passing through the analyzer when the angle between their axes is (i) 0° (ii) 30° (iii) 60° (iv) 90°. (3 marks)
(Polarizer se 80 W m⁻² intensity ki plane polarized light nikalti hai. Analyzer se guzarne wali intensity nikalein jab un ke axes ke darmiyan angle (i) 0° (ii) 30° (iii) 60° (iv) 90° ho.)
blocks.explanation: Har angle ke liye I = I₀cos²θ lagayein; tajurbe ki tarah 90° par light sifar honi chahiye.

book_ref.quote: The light reappears on further rotation and becomes brightest when the axes are again parallel to each other.

blocks.final_answer: 80 W m⁻², 60 W m⁻², 20 W m⁻² aur 0 (90° par light bujh jati hai)

blocks.prompt:
7 What is the polarizing angle? State and derive Brewster's law. What form does it take when the first medium is air? (5 marks)
(Polarizing angle kya hai? Brewster's law bayan karein aur derive karein. Jab pehla medium hawa ho to yeh kya shakal ikhtiyar karta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Polarizing angle: Shaffaf medium par woh khaas angle of incidence jis par reflect hui light taqreeban plane polarized ho.

Derivation: Medium 1 se unpolarized light medium 2 ki satah par parti hai (Fig. 8.6). Jab reflected beam taqreeban plane polarized ho, yani i = θp, to reflected aur refracted beams aapas mein qaima zaviya banati hain. Is liye
θp + θr = 90°
ya θr = 90° − θp

Snell's law se:
n1 sin θp = n2 sin θr
n1 sin θp = n2 sin(90° − θp)
n1 sin θp = n2 cos θp
sin θp / cos θp = n2/n1
tan θp = n2/n1
Yahi Brewster's law hai; n1 aur n2 medium 1 aur 2 ke refractive indices hain.

Medium 1 hawa ho: n1 = 1 aur n2 = n, to tan θp = n. Polarizing angle ka tangent medium 2 ke refractive index ke barabar hai. Woh angle θp jis par reflected aur refracted rays 90° banati hain, Brewster angle θB bhi kehlata hai: tan θB = n.

book_ref.quote: Let a beam of unpolarized light be made incident on the surface of medium 2

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book ki teesri line mein dono taraf n2 chhapa hai; sahi line n1 sin θp = n2 cos θp hai, isi se tan θp = n2/n1 nikalta hai.

blocks.prompt:
8 Light in air falls on a transparent plastic of refractive index 1.65 at the polarizing angle. Find (i) the polarizing angle (ii) the angle of refraction, and check the answer with Snell's law. (3 marks)
(Hawa se light 1.65 refractive index wale shaffaf plastic par polarizing angle par parti hai. (i) polarizing angle (ii) angle of refraction nikalein, aur Snell's law se jawab ki jaanch karein.)
blocks.explanation: tan θp = n lagayein, phir θr = 90° − θp; Snell's law sin θp = n sin θr poora hona chahiye.

book_ref.quote: A beam of light strikes the surface of a plate of glass with a refractive index

blocks.prompt:
9 How can polarized light be obtained by reflection? Describe Malus's observation and explain how a polaroid shows that reflected light is plane or partially polarized. (5 marks)
(Reflection se polarized light kaise hasil ki ja sakti hai? Malus ka mushahida bayan karein aur batayein ke polaroid kaise dikhata hai ke reflect hui light plane ya juzwi polarized hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Daryaft: 1808 mein Malus ne daryaft kiya ke aam light sheeshe ki satah se reflect ho (wapas palte) to polarized light milti hai.

Mushahida: Reflect hui light ko aise polaroid se dekha jata hai jo nazar ki lakeer ke gird ahista ghumaya jaye. Polaroid ki aik position par light taqreeban bujh jati hai. Is se sabit hota hai ke sheeshe se reflect hui light taqreeban plane polarized hai.

Behtareen angle: Sheeshe ke liye behtareen angle of incidence taqreeban 57° hai; is par reflected ray plane polarized ho jati hai (Fig. 8.6). Yahi polarizing angle hai jis par reflected aur refracted rays 90° par hoti hain (Brewster's law, tan θp = n). Reflect hui light plane of incidence ke amoodan polarized hoti hai (dots se dikhayi gayi).

Juzwi polarization: Mez ki satah se reflect hui light ghoomte polaroid se madham dikhti hai, yani juzwi (partially) plane polarized hai. Isi tarah hamwar paani se reflect hui light satah ke mutawazi juzwi polarized hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: In 1808, Malus discovered that polarized light is obtained when ordinary light is reflected

blocks.prompt:
10 Light travelling in water (refractive index 1.33) is reflected from the surface of a glass block (refractive index 1.5) placed in the water. Find the polarizing angle and the angle of refraction. (3 marks)
(Paani (refractive index 1.33) mein chalti light paani mein rakhe sheeshe ke block (refractive index 1.5) ki satah se reflect hoti hai. Polarizing angle aur angle of refraction nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Medium 1 paani hai, hawa nahi, is liye poori shakal tan θp = n2/n1 istemal karein.

book_ref.quote: In this equation, n₁ is refractive index of medium 1

blocks.prompt:
11 What is optical activity? Give examples of optically active substances, the factors on which the rotation depends, its cause, and one use of it. (5 marks)
(Optical activity kya hai? Optically active maaddon ki misalein, rotation kin baaton par munhasir hai, is ki wajah, aur is ka aik istemal bayan karein.)

book_ref.quote: Many crystals and solutions rotate the plane of polarization of light passing through them.

blocks.prompt:
12 Polarized light of intensity 100 W m⁻² passes through a sugar solution that rotates its plane of polarization by 25°. The analyzer is kept with its axis parallel to the original plane of polarization. Find the intensity passing through the analyzer, and the angle through which the analyzer must be turned to get the maximum intensity. (3 marks)
(100 W m⁻² intensity ki polarized light cheeni ke aise solution se guzarti hai jo us ka plane of polarization 25° ghuma deta hai. Analyzer ka axis asal plane of polarization ke mutawazi rakha gaya hai. Analyzer se guzarne wali intensity, aur zyada se zyada intensity ke liye analyzer ko kitna ghumana hoga, nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Solution ke baad light ki satah analyzer ke axis se 25° par hai, is liye θ = 25° ke saath Malus's law lagayein.

book_ref.quote: so that it is no longer horizontal but at an angle

steps: I₀ = 100 W m⁻², plane of polarization aur analyzer axis ka angle θ = 25°
Zyada se zyada intensity (I = I₀) ke liye θ = 0° chahiye, is liye analyzer ko rotation ki simt mein 25° ghumana hoga
blocks.final_answer: I = 82.1 W m⁻²; analyzer ko 25° ghumayein

blocks.prompt:
13 State Malus's law. Derive the relation I = I₀cos²θ and discuss its two extreme conditions. (5 marks)
(Malus's law bayan karein. I = I₀cos²θ ka rishta derive karein aur is ki do intehai halaton par bahas karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Bayan: Analyzer se guzarne ke baad plane polarized light ki intensity I, analyzer aur polarizer ke transmission axes ke darmiyan angle θ ke cosine ke square ke seedha mutanasib hai:
I ∝ cos²θ, ya I = I₀cos²θ
jahan I₀ analyzer par parne wali polarized light (polarizer ke baad) ki intensity hai, Fig. 8.7(a). Analyzer bhi polarizer hi hai jo polarizer ke baad rakha jata hai; ise ghumane se intensity badalti hai.

Derivation: A₀ amplitude ki polarized light analyzer par parti hai jis ka axis plane of polarization se θ angle par hai. A₀ do components mein batt jata hai (Fig. 8.7 b):
A₀cos θ analyzer ke axis ke saath, aur A₀sin θ us ke amoodan.
A₀sin θ analyzer mein jazb ho jata hai; sirf A₀cos θ guzarta hai. Is liye guzarne wala amplitude
A = A₀cos θ
Intensity amplitude ka square hai:
I = A²
ya I = A₀²cos²θ
I = I₀cos²θ (∵ I₀ = A₀²)

Intehai halatein:
• θ = 0°: I = I₀. Analyzer se utni hi intensity guzarti hai jitni polarizer se aayi.
• θ = 90°: I = 0. Light poori tarah bujh jati hai; analyzer se koi light nahi guzarti.

book_ref.quote: When the incident polarized light of amplitude A₀ strikes the analyzer at an angle

blocks.prompt:
14 The intensity of polarized light is to be reduced by 70% using an analyzer. Find the angle between the axes of polarizer and analyzer, and the fraction of the amplitude transmitted. (3 marks)
(Analyzer ke zariye polarized light ki intensity 70% kam karni hai. Polarizer aur analyzer ke axes ke darmiyan angle aur guzarne wale amplitude ka hissa nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: 70% kami ke baad I = 0.30 I₀ bachti hai; I = I₀cos²θ se θ nikalein, aur A/A₀ = cos θ.

book_ref.quote: It is used to further reduce the intensity of light and also adjust it

steps: cos²θ = I/I₀ = 0.30, is liye cos θ = √0.30 = 0.548
blocks.final_answer: θ = 56.8°; amplitude ka taqreeban 0.55 hissa guzarta hai

blocks.prompt:
15 What is a polaroid? Explain the two main applications of polarizers, and list the importance of polarization in other fields. (5 marks)
(Polaroid kya hai? Polarizers ke do bare istemalaat ki wazahat karein, aur doosre shobon mein polarization ki ahmiyat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Polaroid: Tourmaline aur calcite jaise kuch shaffaf crystal maadde light ki vibrations ko sirf aik satah tak mehdood kar dete hain. Crystal structure mein zyada simt-pazeeri wale aise maadde polaroids kehlate hain. Light qudrati taur par reflection, refraction aur scattering se bhi polarize hoti hai.

1. Sky photography: Badalon ki tasveer lene wale camera par polaroid lagaya jata hai. Polarizers fiza ke chhote zarraat se light ke bikharne se bani glare aur haze kam karte hain. Zyada safed roshni rok kar aur baqi rang guzaar kar contrast barhate hain, jis se tasveer roshan, wazeh aur behtar banti hai.

2. Maaddon ka stress analysis: Polarizers plastic, dhaat aur sheeshe mein stress aur strain ke tajziye ke liye istemal hote hain. Stress se molecular structure badalti hai, light se ta'alluq badalta hai aur interference fringes bante hain. Shaffaf maadde mein se polarized light guzaar kar polarization ki tabdeeli dekh kar researchers stress patterns, kamzoriyan ya nuqs, optical khasusiyaat aur mukhtalif halaat mein rawaiya maloom karte hain. Is technique ko photoelasticity kehte hain, jo engineering, materials science aur quality control mein istemal hoti hai.

Doosre shobon mein ahmiyat: optics aur photonics (polarized sunglasses, LCD screens, optical communication); imaging aur microscopy (glare kam, contrast behtar); tib (cancer ki tashkhees, tissue imaging, laser surgery); astronomy (door ke sitaron ki roshni, cosmic microwave background radiation).

book_ref.quote: In both cases described above, polarizers play a crucial role

blocks.prompt:
16 Polarized light from part of the sky reaches a camera polaroid with intensity 150 W m⁻². (i) What intensity passes when the polaroid's axis is at 50° to the plane of polarization? (ii) At what angle would 120 W m⁻² pass? (3 marks)
(Aasmaan ke kisi hisse se polarized light 150 W m⁻² intensity ke saath camera ke polaroid tak pohanchti hai. (i) Jab polaroid ka axis plane of polarization se 50° par ho to kitni intensity guzregi? (ii) Kis angle par 120 W m⁻² guzregi?)
blocks.explanation: Camera ka polaroid analyzer ka kaam karta hai: I = I₀cos²θ dono taraf lagayein.

book_ref.quote: The light coming from the sky is polarized by the polaroid.

blocks.prompt:
17 What are gravitational waves? Explain them with the pond analogy and describe their four basic types. (5 marks)
(Gravitational waves kya hain? Talaab ki misaal se samjhayein aur un ki chaar bunyadi qismein bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: Gravitational waves spacetime ke kapre mein lehrein (ripples) hain jo takrate black holes ya neutron stars jaise shadeed kaainati waqiaat se banti hain, light ki speed se chalti hain aur apne source ki maloomat le jati hain. GW space ka khinchna aur dabna hai jo do cheezon ke darmiyan lambai ki tabdeeli naap kar dekhi jati hai.

Talaab ki misaal: Talaab mein phenka pathar paani ki satah (spacetime) par lehrein banata hai. Lehrein pathar (kaainati waqia) ki maloomat le kar bahar ki taraf chalti hain aur kinare par (GW observatories mein) pakri jati hain.

Chaar bunyadi qismein:
1. Continuous GWs: aik bhaari jism, maslan neutron star, yaksaan raftaar se ghoome to banti hain; aik jaisi frequency aur amplitude. White dwarf binary systems bhi banate hain.
2. Compact binary inspiral GWs: binary system, maslan do neutron stars, do black holes, ya neutron star aur black hole jo aik doosre ke gird ghoomte hain, se banti hain.
3. Burst GWs: supernovae, gamma-ray bursts ya cosmic strings jaise shadeed waqiaat se banti hain.
4. Stochastic GWs: door ke binary systems jaise bohat se kamzor sources ki superposition se bane kamzor, random signals; inhein pakarna sab se mushkil hai.

Har accelerate karne wala jism GWs banata hai, magar Zameen par gaariyon aur jahazon ke mass aur acceleration itne chhote hain ke lehrein pakri nahi jatin.

book_ref.quote: There are four basic types of gravitational waves, each with different sources and characteristics:

blocks.prompt:
18 Taking the speed of gravitational waves as c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹, find (i) the frequency of gravitational waves of wavelength 1200 km (ii) the wavelength of gravitational waves of frequency 150 Hz. (3 marks)
(Gravitational waves ki speed c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹ le kar nikalein: (i) 1200 km wavelength wali GWs ki frequency (ii) 150 Hz frequency wali GWs ki wavelength.)
blocks.explanation: GWs light ki speed se chalti hain, is liye v = fλ ki jagah c = fλ.

book_ref.quote: that travel at the speed of light, carrying information about their source

blocks.prompt:
19 Explain how Einstein's general theory of relativity describes gravity and predicts gravitational waves. What is spacetime distortion (tidal forces), and why is it so hard to detect at the Earth? (5 marks)
(Einstein ka general theory of relativity gravity ko kaise bayan karta hai aur gravitational waves ki paishgoi kaise karta hai? Spacetime distortion (tidal forces) kya hai, aur Zameen par ise pakarna itna mushkil kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation:
General relativity mein gravity: Gravity force nahi balke bhaari ajsaam se spacetime ka kham (curvature) hai. Gadde mein gurhe ki tarah bhaari cheezein apne gird space ko mor deti hain, isi liye hum gravity mehsoos karte hain. Gravitational waves isi theory ki paishgoi hain (Einstein, 1916) jo mushahide se sabit hui; pehli dafa 14 September 2015 ko do milte black holes se pakri gayin.

Sources: Binary system, yani do compact ajsaam (black holes, neutron stars ya white dwarfs) jo aik doosre ke gird ghoomte hain, GWs kharij karta hai. Ghoomte aur accelerate karte masses ki gravitational intensity badalti hai aur lehrein light ki speed se har taraf phailti hain, door jaate hue kamzor hoti hain. In ki khasusiyaat masses, orbital period aur frequency, aur orbit ki eccentricity par munhasir hain.

Spacetime distortion (tidal forces): Kisi jism se guzarti GW us ke gird spacetime ko hilati hai, is liye jism lehar ki simt ke amoodan baar baar khinchta aur dabta hai. Yeh Chaand aur Sooraj se Zameen ke tides ki tarah hai. Miqdaar lehar ki taaqat aur jism ke mass aur size par munhasir hai.

Pakarna mushkil kyun: Zameen tak pohanchne wali GWs ka amplitude sirf taqreeban 10⁻²¹ se 10⁻²² ka strain ΔL/L hai (koi unit nahi). LIGO ke 4 km arms ke liye yeh taqreeban 10⁻¹⁸ m ki tabdeeli hai, is liye intehai hassas aalaat chahiye. Phir bhi GWs se taaqatwar gravity ka mutala, general relativity ki jaanch aur kaainat ki nayi khoj mumkin hai.

book_ref.quote: As the gravitational wave passes through the body, it causes the spacetime around the body to oscillate

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book amplitude ko 10⁻²¹ se 10⁻²² metre likhti hai; sahi yeh hai ke yeh strain (ΔL/L) hai jis ki koi unit nahi. Lambai ki asal tabdeeli strain ko arm ki lambai se zarb de kar milti hai.

blocks.prompt:
20 A gravitational wave of strain ΔL/L = 5 × 10⁻²² passes through the Earth. Find the change in length of (i) a LIGO arm of 4 km (ii) a Virgo arm of 3 km. (3 marks)
(ΔL/L = 5 × 10⁻²² strain wali gravitational wave Zameen se guzarti hai. Lambai mein tabdeeli nikalein: (i) LIGO ka 4 km arm (ii) Virgo ka 3 km arm.)
blocks.explanation: Strain lambai ki fractional tabdeeli hai, is liye ΔL = strain × L, L metre mein.

book_ref.quote: For LIGO's 4 km arms such a wave changes the arm length

blocks.prompt:
21 What is an interferometer? Describe the basic components of a gravitational wave interferometer and explain how it detects a gravitational wave. How does LIGO differ from a conventional interferometer? (5 marks)
(Interferometer kya hai? Gravitational wave interferometer ke bunyadi hisse bayan karein aur batayein ke yeh gravitational wave kaise pakarta hai. LIGO aam interferometer se kaise mukhtalif hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: Interferometer gravitational waves pakarne wala optical aala hai. Yeh bohat hassas aala hai jo LASER beams ka interference istemal karta hai; bunyadi Michelson's interferometer Fig. 8.9 mein hai. GW interferometer LASER light se aainon ke darmiyan faasle ki woh nihayat chhoti tabdeeliyan naapta hai jo guzarti gravitational waves paida karti hain.

Bunyadi hisse:
• Laser: mustahkam aur tez intensity ki light beam banata hai.
• Power recycling mirror: instrument se guzri LASER light ko baar baar wapas interferometer mein bhejta hai.
• Beam splitter: LASER beam ko do amoodi beams mein taqseem karta hai.
• Mirrors: beams ko reflect kar ke do amoodi arms banate hain.
• Fabry Perot cavity: aamne saamne do aaine, raaste ki lambai barhane ke liye.
• Arm cavities: LASER light ko barha kar hassasiyat barhati hain.
• Photodetectors: wapas aane wali beams naap kar chhote phase shifts pakarte hain.

Kaam: Laser beam do amoodi beams mein batt kar do aik jaise arms mein chalti hai. Arms ke siron par aainon se takra kar wapas aati hai aur dobara milti hai, jis se interference pattern banta hai jo photodetector naapta hai. Guzarti GW aainon ka faasla thora sa badalti hai, beams mein phase shift aata hai, interference pattern badalta hai aur detector lehar ko mehsoos karta hai.

LIGO aur aam aala: LIGO aam aale se 1000 guna bara hai, aur LIGO LASER istemal karta hai jab ke aam interferometer mein aam light source hota hai.

book_ref.quote: An interferometer that detects gravitational waves is a highly sensitive instrument

blocks.prompt:
22 A LIGO arm is 4 km long. (i) If LIGO is 1000 times larger than a conventional interferometer, estimate the arm length of the conventional device. (ii) Find the time taken by laser light (speed 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹) to travel down one LIGO arm and back once. (3 marks)
(LIGO ka arm 4 km lamba hai. (i) Agar LIGO aam interferometer se 1000 guna bara hai to aam aale ke arm ki lambai ka andaza lagayein. (ii) Laser light (speed 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹) ko LIGO ke aik arm mein ja kar aik dafa wapas aane mein kitna waqt lagta hai?)

blocks.prompt:
23 Describe the Virgo gravitational wave observatory and compare it with LIGO. Also give an account of the first observation of gravitational waves. (5 marks)
(Virgo gravitational wave observatory bayan karein aur LIGO se muqabla karein. Gravitational waves ke pehle mushahide ka ahwaal bhi likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Virgo: LIGO ki tarah Virgo bhi gravitational waves naapne ki jagah hai. Yeh European Gravitational Observatory (EGO) ke tehat Cascina, Pisa ke qareeb, Italy mein kaam karti hai. Yeh 3 km ke do arms wala interferometer hai, jab ke LIGO (USA) ke arms 4 km ke hain. Is ka naam Virgo constellation par hai jo March, April aur May mein raat ko nazar aata hai. Virgo cluster taqreeban 1,500 galaxies ka group hai jo taqreeban 50 million light years door hai; aik light year woh faasla hai jo light aik saal mein tay karti hai, taqreeban 9.46 × 10¹² km. Virgo ne pehli GW detection 2017 mein ki.

Pehla mushahida: 14 September 2015 ko LIGO ne pehli dafa gravitational waves dekhin. Einstein ki 100 saal pehle ki paishgoi wali yeh lehrein do black holes ke takrao se aayi theen aur USA mein LIGO detector tak pohanchne mein 1.3 billion saal lage. Is kaam par Rainer Weiss, Barry C. Barish aur Kip S. Thorne ko 2017 ka Nobel Prize in Physics mila. Team ki aik rukn, MIT ki professor Nergis Mavalvala, Pakistan se ta'alluq rakhti hain.

book_ref.quote: Similar to LIGO, there is another facility for measuring gravitational waves.

rows: 14 September 2015 ko pehli dafa GWs dekhin.

24 The first gravitational waves observed travelled for 1.3 billion years at the speed of light, and the Virgo cluster is 50 million light years away. Taking 1 light year = 9.46 × 10¹² km, find (i) the distance travelled by those waves (ii) the distance of the Virgo cluster, both in km. (3 marks)
(Pehli dekhi gayi gravitational waves light ki speed se 1.3 billion saal chalti rahin, aur Virgo cluster 50 million light years door hai. 1 light year = 9.46 × 10¹² km le kar nikalein: (i) un lehron ka tay kiya faasla (ii) Virgo cluster ka faasla, dono km mein.)
blocks.explanation: Light ki speed se N saal chalne wali lehrein N light years tay karti hain; aik light year ke km se zarb dein.
